acceptance_criteria: Parent-directory open failure never returns ordinary durable success.
Parent-directory fsync failure never returns ordinary durable success.
File-content flush, rename, directory-open, directory-sync, chmod, cleanup, and reconciliation failures have distinct bounded outcomes.
A post-rename failure is classified as ambiguous or unproven and reconciled by stable generation or event identity.
Emitter and runner cannot report an event queued until its namespace receipt is durable.
Collector, dispatcher, health, watchdog, q-loop, selfcheck, and sentinel cannot advance durable state obligations from an unproven generation.
Same-parent and cross-parent mutations sync the exact required directory set.
Fault-injection tests cover EACCES, EMFILE, ENFILE, unsupported directory sync, disk I/O failure, interruption after rename, and cleanup failure.
A structural guard verifies behavior with injected failures; source-string presence of fsync_parent is not accepted as sufficient proof.
Runtime bundles pin one coherent shared-helper generation and fail closed on mixed or missing versions.
Tests, logs, health, issues, and pull requests contain no private host, account, runtime path, process, event, message, destination, credential, or topology value.
blast_radius: File-backed BOT ERRORS event publication and controller state across emitter, runner, collector, dispatcher, daily health, heartbeat watchdog, q-loop, selfcheck, and sentinel; downstream queue, suppression, recovery, health, and escalation decisions can inherit the false durable-success result. No production state was inspected or mutated.
evidence_summary: At origin/main a91f5301266fae2049cd1ae1b3c1b236a7ea2aa8, a deterministic AST census found all nine principal atomic JSON writers flush and fsync file content and atomically replace the target, then mask OSError while obtaining the parent-directory descriptor: three inline and six through fsync_parent. Existing selfcheck and sentinel tests explicitly exercise the ignored-open-error contract. The only change from the issue's original pin touches design-regression files outside this evidence surface. Current review still finds principal JSON writers that can report ordinary success after parent-directory durability becomes unproven; one typed certainty and stage contract remains required. A final path-level audit found every recorded decisive, test, and affected path disjoint from the exact 6e1672766027c16ecb06f5e122b491c0e5a0a83f to 45f4889ab5f971d920ca6a05bf857d326c42b81d delta; API and SSH main matched the latter revision, so this record is safely repinned. falsifier_or_remaining_gap: This read-only audit did not rerun the issue's filesystem fault-injection harness because the task prohibited temporary-file mutation. On the implementation head, inject each required parent-open, directory-fsync, post-rename interruption, cleanup, and reconciliation fault across all nine callers; ordinary queued, saved, healthy, healed, or recovered success must remain impossible until an exact durable or reconciled generation receipt exists.
impact: A caller can publish queued, saved, healthy, healed, or recovered success after the target becomes visible but before the namespace update is proven durable, allowing a sudden restart or storage fault to erase state that later decisions treated as committed while producing no bounded durability diagnostic.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read live issue identity, body hash, labels, origin/main, and every open pull-request changed-path inventory immediately before assigning an implementation owner.
Land one RED fault matrix for all nine writers before changing the contract, including parent-open, directory-fsync, post-rename interruption, and cleanup outcomes.

Coordinate the shared primitive and coherent deployment bundle with issue #2464, state-generation reconciliation with #2463, and cross-directory queue transitions with #2482 without collapsing their owner boundaries.
Prove that post-rename ambiguity reconciles by stable generation or event identity and cannot blindly duplicate or discard an event or state obligation.
Verify isolated-bundle import, manifest hashing, mixed-generation rejection, rollback, content-free diagnostics, and the focused component suites on the exact implementation head.

After a rename, reconcile stable generation or event identity before retry; make best-effort persistence an explicit weaker API with metadata-only diagnostics; migrate the nine callers under one fault matrix, bundle manifest, structural drift guard, and coherent rollback contract.
